newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sale of Brazil CVRD postponed - paper.
newsitem.headline: Sale of Brazil CVRD postponed - paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government has decided to delay the schedule for the privatization of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a financial newspaper said.

The president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros, said the time schedule for the privatization had to be extended as more companies than expected had applied to view the information on CVRD which is on display at the BNDES, Gazeta Mercantil said.
The announcement of CVRD's minimum price scheduled for December 17, as well as the sale of an initial 40-45 percent share block due in mid-February will now be delayed, Gazeta said.

"The delay will be for the time necessary to allow all interested firms to have access to the information they need to evaluate the company correctly," Barros was quoted as saying by Gazeta. "Thirty or sixty days will not compromise the CVRD privatization process."
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
